name: lanes
description: A collection of tools for flat-to-VR AI modding with Claude: skills, helper programs and checks for Claude Code that take a flat-screen PC game into VR, from the first look inside the game to the build you wear in the headset. Among them: tools that see and drive a running game, a robot VR tester, a shared work board, and session lanes that keep several Claude sessions out of each other's way.
